# Health Cluster Colombia — Situation Report #1

- Source: Clúster Salud Colombia + Global Health Cluster, with PAHO/WHO. Rating **A**.
- Reporting period: from impact to **13 Aug 2026 17:00** local.
- Published on ReliefWeb 14 Aug 2026 (originally 13 Aug).
- Pulled 14 Aug 2026 12:0x UTC by the scheduled refresh.

## Why it matters to the dossier

- First **department-level casualty split**: Valle del Cauca 146 dead / 2,819 injured;
  Risaralda 99 dead / 1,072 injured (corte 13.8). More than half the national injured are in Valle.
- Cali: hospital network "stabilised" but **hospital red alert still in force**; only **one**
  coordinated health partner active in the city (PAHO/WHO).
- Distinguishes **59 health facilities with damage verified by assessment teams** from a further
  109 reported by UNGRD without verification — explains the spread between published totals.
- Names Cali's requested items: structural assessment, trauma/referral, **tents, water tanks,
  backup power**, WASH.
- Buenaventura is a separate operational priority within Valle and asks for **field hospitals**.
- Coordination entry point for any medical contribution: colombia.healthcluster.org.

No personal data. Nothing here identifies a missing person.
